scenes.title: He started IKEA at 17
scenes.sub: With a gift from his dad

scenes.label: Ingvar Kamprad registers IKEA with a cash reward for good grades
scenes.say: In nineteen forty three, Ingvar Kamprad used a cash reward from his father for good grades to start the company.

scenes.label: after selling pens and wallets, IKEA starts selling furniture
scenes.say: He sold pens and wallets first. Furniture only came five years later.

scenes.title: Start small. Start now.
scenes.say: Start small, but start. Follow for more founder stories.
